notes.title: Friday Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Can you raed sutff lkie taht? Yeah, me too, it's weird right? Anyway, let's get to the changelog for today's update:

[h1]Patch highlight[/h1]
[list]
[*]Split screen online multiplayer is available! Play online with both your close and distant friends.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ewSqPmh.png[/img]
And as you can see, we also changed the lobby quite a bit.
[/list]
[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]New option: Shield Multiplier.
[*]New option: Death Match win condition. It can be either "Max Kills" or "Min Deaths" (mostly useful for Solo Death Match).
[*]Added a recommended ship count during map selection.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the player to score with the ball hitting the back of the goal.
[*]Minor UI fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
It's time for another update of G.O.D.S:

[h1]Patch highlight[/h1]
[list]
[*]You are now able to save your game rules to nameable templates!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/teuwmDT.png[/img]
We already added a few on our own, but don't hesitate to create even more!
[/list]

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bonuses can all be set to On or Off by pressing Y (gamepad) or Tab (keyboard) on the Bonuses part of the rules editing window.
[*]The local play menu now looks more like the online lobby: the map is now chosen by pressing Back (gamepad) or X (keyboard) and the background changes depending on the map you chose.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a small bug with focussing UI elements with the mouse.
[*]AIs will now come for you if you start hiding the ball behind your goal.
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi fellow players, we hope you're all enjoying the game now that it's out of early access! For our first update after this big release, we're fixing bugs and improving things around:

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]The tutorial now includes a small explanation about the shield around the ships.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the automatic scrolling bug when editing the rules of a match.
[*]Some achievements weren't unlockable while in online multiplayer.
[*]The Tab shortcut used to invite friends in the lobby now works properly.
[*]Fixed a bug where AIs could stay stuck on the map Quagmire.
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Update 0.9.18
notes.notes:
Good day everyone, I hope you all enjoyed the update we pushed earlier this week! This time it's mostly bug fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*]Brand new help videos for the bonuses.
[*]The BFGL has a cool impact effect now.
[*]Every single collision box in the game was revised to become more logical and/or pleasant, tell us what you think.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where launching a BFGL would prevent the player to move in an online match.
[*]Ships aren't black anymore in the multiplayer lobby.
[*]Small fixes for the online mode (we're getting there).
[*]Fixed a bug where the user couldn't click the arrows on the map selection screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Update 0.9.16
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just a few words from the dev team to keep you in touch. As you may have seen, we didn’t push any huge update since a few weeks. Don’t worry, we are still working on the game but as promised on the steam page, we are really close to the final release and we want to propose you the real experience that we imagined but it requires a lot of work.

[u]"What will be included in this final release?"[/u]
That’s a good question. We want to bring you a stable and playable experience online, a massive graphic improvement (and yeah that will be massive) and the funniest gameplay possible.

[u]"Will it be the last update?"[/u]
No, it’s more symbolic: the game will be officially released like we imagined it at first (and in fact even better, thanks to all of you) and the version will be 1.x.x but it won’t be the last update, we want to continue bringing you new environments, new gamemodes etc.

[u]"Can we see some screenshots or trailers of this version?"[/u]
Really soon, we are going to publish them on the Mech’at twitter [url=https://twitter.com/MechatStudio]here[/url] and on the facebook page [url=https://www.facebook.com/GODSportGame/]here[/url], so if you follow us, you will see them really quickly.

But enough talk, let's get to the changelog:

[h1]Patch highlight[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ever wished you could have a BFGL only game? Well, now it's possible!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FNZUDQF.png[/img]
That's right, you can control which bonus you want and don't want for your match.
[/list]

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Your ship's speed is now affecting the speed of your lasers: if your ship fires in the same direction it's moving, the lasers will be faster by a certain percentage of the ship's speed. Shots on the opposite direction are not affected by this mechanic.
[*]Great improvements for network synchronisation on ships and lasers: it's just better.
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Update 0.9.14
notes.notes:
In this week's update we have some amazing new content we're sure you'll like:

[h1]Patch highlight[/h1]
[list]
[*]We've talked about this for a long time, and now it's here: the online multiplayer in beta version!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gl64vw6.png[/img]
You can now play with your friends via Steam invites! For now, every lobby created is private and requires the host to invite the other players.
As stated earlier it's a beta, which means that this mode is not customizable yet (don't worry, it will come soon). You may also experience bugs, in which case, please report them to us.
[/list]

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]The dash cooldown is now reset on death.
[*]During the ship selection, you can now click on the top and bottom of the wheel to scroll.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where turret would spawn too many lasers when a target was approaching (potentially freezing the game).
[*]Less visual artifacts for the BFGL.
[/list]

For those who already forgot, there won't be any update next week, so see you all in two weeks! Happy game everyone!

notes.title: Friday Update 0.9.4
notes.notes:
As the holidays are drawing closer and closer, we too have decided to put on some decoration: doesn't it feel cozy and warm now? The team also brought you a lot of improvements and fixes for you this week:

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Camera zoom is now saved between games.
[*]It is now possible to join the match by clicking anywhere on the ship selection screen.
[*]It is now possible to choose its ship and team by clicking on the ship itself.
[*]Players are now emphasised on the detailed statistics menu at the end of a match
[*]Keybindings now match most keyboard layouts the first time the game is started.
[*]Computers without DirectX 11 now have a static grid in the background.
[*]The grid is now more fluid and have better light effects.
[*]The camera will now follow the ships faster when zoomed in.
[*]The random attribution of bonuses changed to guarantee more diversity.
[*]Better interpolation of the shots.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the example videos would not appear at all in the "Bonuses" menu under "Help".
[*]Possibility to switch correctly between fullscreen and windowed with the shortcut "Alt + Return" without losing the setting when changing a scene.
[*]Inputs explanations are now accurate and better looking for the keyboard.
[*]Fixed a bug where the light intensity was not set back to its correct value after a goal.
[*]Fixed a bug that could make the UI disappear during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed a bug where a same resolution could appear many time in the graphics options.
[/list]

Next week, normal updates will be back.

In the meantime, enjoy everyone!

notes.title: Friday Update 0.9.4
notes.notes:
As the holidays are drawing closer and closer, we too have decided to put on some decoration: doesn't it feel cozy and warm now? The team also brought you a lot of improvements and fixes for you this week:

[h1]General updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Camera zoom is now saved between games.
[*]It is now possible to join the match by clicking anywhere on the ship selection screen.
[*]It is now possible to choose its ship and team by clicking on the ship itself.
[*]Players are now emphasised on the detailed statistics menu at the end of a match
[*]Keybindings now match most keyboard layouts the first time the game is started.
[*]Computers without DirectX 11 now have a static grid in the background.
[*]The grid is now more fluid and have better light effects.
[*]The camera will now follow the ships faster when zoomed in.
[*]The random attribution of bonuses changed to guarantee more diversity.
[*]Better interpolation of the shots.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the example videos would not appear at all in the "Bonuses" menu under "Help".
[*]Possibility to switch correctly between fullscreen and windowed with the shortcut "Alt + Return" without losing the setting when changing a scene.
[*]Inputs explanations are now accurate and better looking for the keyboard.
[*]Fixed a bug where the light intensity was not set back to its correct value after a goal.
[*]Fixed a bug that could make the UI disappear during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed a bug where a same resolution could appear many time in the graphics options.
[/list]

Next week, normal updates will be back.

In the meantime, enjoy everyone!
